correctness.rationale: Exact Lie differentiation gives \(L(z+bx-ay)=y(y+a)\) and, with \(w=x-y\), \(v=Lw=y-x-z\), \(H=wv+(1-b)w^2/2+ay^2/2+y^3/3\), gives \(LH=v^2-(a-b)w^2\). The \(a\le b\) rigidity follows from nonnegativity and support invariance; the \(a>b\) sign excursion follows from the sign of \(y(y+a)\); and the strict period floor follows from Wirtinger plus exclusion of its first-harmonic equality case by the quadratic second harmonic. The embedded exact checker returns VERIFY_OK.
